confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Honduran price levels, not checked against live menus, listings, or booking pages. La Ceiba is a small city with limited published price data, so all anchors carry wide uncertainty; accommodation and mid-range restaurant figures are the least certain. The FX observation comes from search-result excerpts describing the RBA exchange rates overview page; I did not open the RBA page directly. A third-party site's claimed 16 October 2026 figure was not used because it could not be confirmed against rba.gov.au.
comparable_city_reasoning: No direct comparable was used. Estimates reflect general Honduran price levels, informed by other mid-sized Honduran and Central American north-coast tourist towns, adjusted for La Ceiba's role as a gateway to Pico Bonito and the Bay Islands ferries. Drink prices are set at ordinary local venues rather than resort or expatriate bars.
